hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Oceania, group of islands in the South Pacific Ocean, about halfway between Hawaii and New Zealand || two main islands (Savaii, Upolu) and several smaller islands and uninhabited islets; narrow coastal plain with volcanic, rugged mountains in interior || occupies an almost central position within Polynesia || Resources: hardwood forests, fish, hydropower || Exports: refined petroleum, integrated circuits, coconut oil, fish, insulated wire (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: two main islands (Savaii, Upolu) and several smaller islands and uninhabited islets; narrow coastal plain with volcanic, rugged mountains in interior || Oceania, group of islands in the South Pacific Ocean, about halfway between Hawaii and New Zealand

climate.excerpt: tropical; rainy season (November to April), dry season (May to October) || occasional cyclones; active volcanism volcanism: Savai'I Island (1,858 m) is historically active

economy.excerpt: ower middle-income Pacific island economy; enormous fishing and agriculture industries; significant remittances; growing offshore financial hub; recently hosted Pacific Games to drive tourism and infrastructure growth || Exports: refined petroleum, integrated circuits, coconut oil, fish, insulated wire (2023) || Industries: food processing, building materials, auto parts
